page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Running on a KVM hypervisor, the server delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps to support standard cloud networking requirements.

Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU configured with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local disk storage, which necessitates reliance on network-attached storage volumes for operating system disks and application data persistence.

Integrating an entry-level GPU offers compute efficiency for specialized parallel processing tasks without the higher hardware overhead of full-scale training nodes. The primary tradeoff is the requirement for external storage for disk operations. This server configuration is best suited for machine learning inference, computer vision tasks, image processing, and real-time video transcoding.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for entry-level acceleration tasks. Built on x86_64 architecture using a KVM hypervisor, it features 4 dedicated vCPUs, 16.0 GB of system memory (4.0 GB per core), and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance comes equipped with one NVIDIA P4 GPU providing 8 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not included, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data needs. The integration of an NVIDIA P4 GPU offers cost-effective execution of inference models and media workflows relative to CPU-only nodes, though storage capabilities depend on network disk performance. Recommended workloads include machine learning inference, computer vision pipelines, image processing, and real-time video transcoding.
